## Summary
Build a greenfield full-stack app: React + Vite + React Router SPA served by an Express + better-sqlite3 API with JWT email/password auth and roles, packaged as a single Docker image.

## Scope
### Files to modify
- `README.md` — replace stub with setup/run/seed instructions.

### Files to create
**Backend (`server/`)**
- `server/package.json` — Express, better-sqlite3, bcryptjs, jsonwebtoken, zod, cors; scripts `dev`, `build`, `start`, `seed`.
- `server/tsconfig.json` — Node/TS build config.
- `server/src/db.ts` — better-sqlite3 connection; schema bootstrap (`users`, `books`, `loans`) via `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`; DB path from `DATABASE_PATH` env (default `./data/library.db`).
- `server/src/auth.ts` — `hashPassword`, `verifyPassword`, `signToken`, `authMiddleware` (Bearer JWT → `req.user`), `requireRole('ADMIN')`.
- `server/src/routes/auth.ts` — `POST /api/auth/login`, `GET /api/auth/me`.
- `server/src/routes/books.ts` — CRUD `GET/POST /api/books`, `GET/PUT/DELETE /api/books/:id` (auth required).
- `server/src/routes/loans.ts` — `GET /api/loans?status=`, `POST /api/loans`, `POST /api/loans/:id/return`; USER scoped to own rows, ADMIN sees all.
- `server/src/routes/admin.ts` — `GET /api/admin/users` (ADMIN only).
- `server/src/routes/health.ts` — `GET /api/health` → `{"status":"ok"}`.
- `server/src/app.ts` — Express app: JSON, CORS, mount routers, static-serve SPA build + non-`/api` catch-all → `index.html`.
- `server/src/index.ts` — start server on `PORT` (default 8080).
- `server/src/seed.ts` — seed ADMIN + USER; print `SEED_CRED <ROLE> <email> <password>` per account and one `SEED_CREDS_JSON <json-array>` line.

**Frontend (`web/`)**
- `web/package.json`, `web/vite.config.ts` (dev proxy `/api`→backend), `web/tsconfig.json`, `web/index.html`.
- `web/src/main.tsx` — bootstrap `BrowserRouter`.
- `web/src/api.ts` — fetch wrapper injecting JWT from storage.
- `web/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx` — token/user state, `login`, `logout`; loads `/api/auth/me`.
- `web/src/auth/RequireAuth.tsx` / `RequireAdmin.tsx` — guards redirecting to `/login`.
- `web/src/routes/Login.tsx`, `Books.tsx`, `BookDetail.tsx`, `Loans.tsx`, `Admin.tsx`.
- `web/src/routes/AppRoutes.tsx` — route table (below).
- `web/src/components/Layout.tsx` — nav + "Lending Ledger" dashboard heading.

**Deploy**
- `Dockerfile` — multi-stage: build `web` → build `server` → runtime copies server dist + web `dist` into static dir; runs seed then `node dist/index.js`.
- `.dockerignore`, `docker-entrypoint.sh` (seed-on-boot, idempotent).

### Dependencies
- Backend: `express`, `better-sqlite3`, `bcryptjs`, `jsonwebtoken`, `zod`, `cors`, `typescript`, `tsx`.
- Frontend: `react`, `react-dom`, `react-router-dom`, `vite`, `typescript`.

### Assumptions
- Stack: React+Vite+RR (frontend), Express+better-sqlite3 (backend), single Docker image — no external DB service.
- No `/signup`; accounts seeded only (spec lists no signup route). First-class login only.
- Books catalog is shared across authenticated users; loans are per-user (ADMIN sees all).
- `overdue` is derived (`status='lent' AND due_date < now`); filter values `lent|returned|overdue|all`.
- JWT in `localStorage`; `JWT_SECRET` env (dev fallback constant).

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Backend scaffold & DB
**File:** `server/src/db.ts`, `server/package.json`, `server/tsconfig.json`
**Change:** Init Express project; create tables — `users(id, email UNIQUE, password_hash, role, created_at)`, `books(id, title, author, genre, isbn, shelf_location, created_at)`, `loans(id, book_id, borrower_name, due_date, status, returned_at, user_id, created_at)`.

### Step 2: Auth
**File:** `server/src/auth.ts`, `server/src/routes/auth.ts`
**Change:** bcrypt hashing, JWT sign/verify, `authMiddleware`, `requireRole`. Login validates credentials → returns token + user; `/api/auth/me` returns current user.

### Step 3: Books, Loans, Admin, Health routes
**File:** `server/src/routes/*.ts`, `server/src/app.ts`
**Change:** Implement books CRUD; loans list with `status` filter + role scoping; return action sets `status='returned'`, `returned_at`; admin users list; health endpoint. Add SPA static serve + catch-all fallback.

### Step 4: Seed script
**File:** `server/src/seed.ts`
**Change:** Upsert one ADMIN + one USER with known passwords; emit `SEED_CRED ADMIN ...`, `SEED_CRED USER ...`, and one `SEED_CREDS_JSON [{"role","email","password"}...]` line to stdout.

### Step 5: Frontend scaffold + routing
**File:** `web/src/routes/AppRoutes.tsx`, `main.tsx`
**Change:** Routes — `/login` (public); guarded: `/books`, `/books/:id`, `/loans` (reads `?status=` query), `/admin` (admin-only), `/` → redirect `/books`. Each guarded route wrapped in `RequireAuth`; `/admin` in `RequireAdmin`. Every navigable state is URL-addressable (loan filter via `?status=`, book detail via `:id`).

### Step 6: Auth context + API client
**File:** `web/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx`, `web/src/api.ts`
**Change:** Store token, attach `Authorization: Bearer`, redirect to `/login` on 401; guards redirect signed-out users.

### Step 7: Pages
**File:** `web/src/routes/*.tsx`, `components/Layout.tsx`
**Change:** Login form; Books list + add/edit/delete; BookDetail fetched by `:id` (fresh-load safe); Loans list driven by URL `status`, log-loan form, mark-returned; Admin user table; Layout with "Lending Ledger" dashboard heading.

### Step 8: Docker + deploy
**File:** `Dockerfile`, `docker-entrypoint.sh`
**Change:** Multi-stage build; runtime seeds DB (emitting SEED lines) then serves API + SPA on one port so deep links resolve in production.

## Testing Strategy
- `curl /api/health` → `200 {"status":"ok"}`.
- Run seed → assert `SEED_CRED` lines + one `SEED_CREDS_JSON` line; log in with each.
- Add book via API/UI → appears in list and `/books/:id` renders on fresh reload.
- Create loan due next week → status `lent`; mark returned → `returned`; persists across reload.
- Open `/loans?status=overdue` directly → only overdue rows render.
- Signed-out load of `/books` → redirect `/login`; USER cannot reach `/admin`; ADMIN sees users list.

## Risks
- SPA fallback must exclude `/api/*` or API calls break — order routes carefully.
- better-sqlite3 needs matching native build in the Docker runtime stage (use same Node base image).
- Seed must be idempotent (upsert) so repeated container boots don't error or duplicate accounts.
- Overdue filtering is date-derived — ensure consistent UTC comparison between seed/data and query.
